sample_original: I find be that the cardinal is with that is veil mynded to help me; [..] for find meanes that our caus[e] be not [lost] for falt of solisitation: vreit to the B[ishop of Ross] of your part
sample_en: I find by that [letter] that the cardinal is well minded to help me; ... find means that our cause be not lost for lack of solicitation: write to the Bishop of Ross on your part
why: Scots-English spelling is readable but about half of the 23 lines carry [..] holes or unkeyed signs (lines 1, 4-6, 8-10, 12-17), so the argument only partially builds; the transcriber flags it as read line by line with gaps.

label: George Lasry's reading (report status: Transcribed; Deciphered); only the excerpt from his report is in the repository
sample_original: Com tudo me pareceo lembrarvos que com aquelle rei se deve trata[r] com todo o segredo por que os Olandezes se nam dem por ofendidos.
sample_en: Nevertheless, it seemed right to remind you that dealings with that king must be conducted with complete secrecy so that the Dutch do not take offence.
why: The excerpt (two lines of the cipher passage with translation) is clean Portuguese; the rest of the 257-element letter is not in the repository.

label: Orangist correspondent at Basle to William V, 17 Aug 1796 (DECODE R2234)
sample_original: Depuis le 12 juillet je n'ai pas reçu de vos nouvelles; quel silence! J'attends sans faute une lettre pour le 4 septembre, pour me décider ou à renoncer ou à reprendre ma maison pour 3 mois
sample_en: Since 12 July I have had no news from you; what silence! I am awaiting without fail a letter by 4 September, to decide whether to give up or take my house again for three months
why: Full letter in punctuated French with only about five [..] gaps in 22 lines; fully translatable.

label: R483, Lwów, 27 June 1711
sample_original: Leopoli vigesima septima Junii 1711mo ... Fideli nobis sincere dilecte, Supprimimus ... copiam Tractatus sic dictae Pacis Carolianae aula Viennensi
sample_en: Lwów, 27 June 1711. To our faithful and sincerely beloved ... we enclose a copy of the treaty of the so-called Caroline Peace [offered] by the Viennese court
why: Latin merged from the clerk's interlinear decipherment and clear passages; the large themes (peace of Vienna, Palatine and the Diet) can be followed, but most lines carry ? doubts or alternatives (latens?/haerens?), a struck stroke and a few unreadable words, so many sentences are only half secure.

label: BnF espagnol 336 no. 99 ff. 196r-198r, Madrid, 8 Aug 1596
sample_original: Un consejero muy grave me ha dicho que han hecho aquí junta sobre la cometa que ha avido estos días, y dizen que el mundo se acabará o morirá el rey por setiembre. Él bien cerca dello paresce que anda. Creo en Dios.
sample_en: A very grave councillor has told me that they have held a meeting here about the comet seen these days, and they say that the world will end or the king will die by September. He seems to be very near it. I believe in God.
why: The two cipher passages (125 tokens) are fully read as Spanish sentences, with only six doubtful values; the other pages of the letter are in clear and only summarised.

label: R4794 (unnumbered), a slip wholly in cipher on pieces of artillery, 16th century (George Lasry)
sample_original: Di alcuni pezzi [d']i artigliaria 44 di 26. Le Signorie Vostre, come so, faranno si governin con prudentia, perché ancho 67 ha qualche impressio[n], non è la mente che Vostre Signorie s'intendino col presente 74 di 26.
sample_en: Concerning some pieces of artillery of 44 of 26. Your Lordships, as I know, will see that matters are governed prudently, because 67 too has some suspicion; it is not intended that Your Lordships should come to an understanding with the present 74 of 26.
why: Complete 165-symbol slip in two clear Italian sentences with Lasry's translation; only four number codes unidentified.

label: R4306, Riksarkivet Chifferklaver låda II:133, a Dutch cipher letter to Amsterdam, [1632?] (George Lasry)
sample_original: Ic sal mondelinge ... antwoorden. Als ooc des saecken kan seer grooten gewichte syn ende metbrengen, antwoort op U.L. versoeck met paspoorten hier.
sample_en: I will answer by word of mouth. As this matter may be of very great weight, I answer your request with passports here.
why: The one cipher page reads as Dutch sentences with five code values bracketed and two doubtful words; the address-leaf note is a proposal and is not read in full (not counted).

label: George Lasry's excerpt and translation (BnF cipher research, 10 Oct 2026)
sample_original: J'ay fait icy le plus de caresses que j'ay pu à Kerim Bey ; & quoique je n'aye pu avoir avec luy aucune conférence, j'ay lieu d'estre content des disposition favorables qu'il a fait paroître pour notre nation
sample_en: I showed Kerim Bey as much favour as I could here, and although I could not confer with him, I have reason to be pleased with the favourable disposition he showed toward our nation
why: Three excerpts with translations of an 815-element letter set are clean French (a few ? in the translation of one); only the excerpts are in the repository.

label: R5029, Brussels, 18 Nov 1721
sample_original: Ich glaube es heisset bey «Rialp?» manus manum lavat ... In puncto «der/dem» «Compagnie» ist fast nicht zu glauben, wie nicht allein «die» «Kaiserin?» sondern auch sonsten jederman «die» LIEBE vor «Eugen» ia selbsten «Kayser» täglich «mehr?» VERLIEHRET
sample_en: I believe it is with Rialp as "one hand washes the other" ... In the matter of the Company it is hardly to be believed how not only the Empress but everybody else is more and more losing love for Eugene and the Emperor himself
why: Line-by-line German with code-word guesses in «?» marks; some lines (p3L) translate, but many others (p3R, p4L, p4R) have ellipses, bare numbers and lowercase/uppercase fragments, so roughly half the sentences have holes.
